content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I would like to know the maximum distance possible for connecting a link between two [product_name] devices (version [article_no]) over Ethernet.
Hello, Using a Cat 5/6 cable, the direct distance limit is 100 meters. Regards,

Hi, It is also possible to increase the distance by using a media converter and fiber optic cable. The achievable distance depends on the converter and cable, but it is not uncommon to reach up to 3 km.
